**Yes — this is the second time, same line, same command.** `01M22R72FHNB` (High, conf 0.85) claimed `brew trust` isn't a real subcommand at all; I dismissed it on 2026-09-07. This one concedes it exists but claims the bare form is invalid without `--tap`. Same conclusion — "the macOS leg can never work" — same line, same wrongness.

Disproven three ways:

**The help text.** `Usage: brew trust [options] [target ...]` — options are optional, the target is positional. `--tap` is a *disambiguator* for when you want to force interpretation, not a requirement.

**Homebrew's own advice.** From our earlier run log, when Homebrew itself warns about an untrusted tap it suggests the bare form: `Trust whole taps with: brew trust aws/tap`. And [docs.brew.sh/Tap-Trust](https://docs.brew.sh/Tap-Trust) documents exactly our three-line sequence with no flag.

**It ran green yesterday.** From run 34355971681, the macOS leg, under `shell: /bin/bash -e {0}`:

```
brew tap entireio/tap
brew trust entireio/tap
==> Tapping entireio/tap
Tapped 3 casks (18 files, 169.8KB).
Trusted tap: entireio/tap
==> Would install 1 cask: entireio/tap/entire@nightly
✔︎ Cask entire@nightly (0.10.7-nightly.202609090626.b58e65cd7)
```

Step conclusion: `success`. Note `Trusted tap:` — Homebrew resolved the bare argument to a tap correctly, which is precisely what the finding says it can't do. That line has now passed under `set -euo pipefail` in four separate runs.

Both findings trace to one root: tap trust shipped in **Homebrew 6.0.0 on 2026-06-11**, three months ago. A model whose priors predate it will confidently reconstruct a Homebrew without the feature — first as "no such command", now as "wrong invocation". Worth watching for a third variant.

**CLI flags** (`:40-42`): `-color` (bool, force ANSI) and `-o <file>` (write ANSI to `<file>` and a stripped copy to `<file minus .txt>.nocolor.txt`). Input path is `flag.Arg(0)`; empty means stdin (`openInput`, `:72-77`).

**Parsing** (`parseEvents`, `:79-157`): line-scans the gotestsum `--jsonfile` as JSON-lines into `TestEvent{Action,Package,Test,Elapsed,Output}` (`:17-23`), 1 MiB max line (`:81`). Two filters matter:
- `:93-95` — unparseable lines are silently skipped.
- **`:96-98` — `if ev.Test == "" { continue }`**: every package-level event is dropped. This is why a `-run` that matches nothing yields zero parents.

Each test name accumulates a terminal `action` (`pass`/`fail`/`skip`) plus `Elapsed`, and all `output` lines (`:106-112`).

**What a "parent" is** (`:32-37`, `:115-142`): names are split on the **first `/`** (`splitTestName`, `:159-165`). No `/` ⇒ it's a `parentTest` and the event's action becomes `p.action` (`:126-127`). With a `/` ⇒ a `*subtest` appended to `p.children` (`:136-141`). This exactly mirrors the suite's shape: `runForAgents` (`e2e/testutil/repo.go:410-456`) creates one subtest per agent under each top-level test, so children are agent names.

**Counting** (`renderReport`, `:167-187`):
```go
var total, passed, failed, skipped int
for _, p := range parents {
    total++
    switch p.action {
    case "pass":  passed++
    case "fail":  failed++
    case "skip":  skipped++
    }
}
```
**Counts are parent-only.** Children are rendered (`:197-215`) but never counted.

**Every `os.Exit`** — three, all I/O, none content-driven:
- `:49` — `openInput` failed (missing/unreadable jsonfile).
- `:60` — writing `-o` file failed.
- `:66` — writing the `.nocolor.txt` companion failed.

**Does it ever exit non-zero on report content?** **No.** With `failed > 0` it prints the red `💥 FAILED (%d/%d passed) 💥` banner (`:246-252`) and still returns 0. With zero parents it prints `Total: 0  Passed: 0  Failed: 0  Skipped: 0` and `🎉 ALL 0 TESTS PASSED 🎉` (`:253-259`).

**Can "no test produced a pass or fail verdict" be computed here? Yes — the data is present and unambiguous.**
- Every leaf carries a terminal `Action` of exactly one of `pass` / `fail` / `skip` (`:107`). The set of leaves is: each `p.children[i]`, plus each `p` with `len(p.children) == 0` (the standalone case testreport already special-cases at `:237-240`).

Four parents ran nothing and were counted as passes.
- So the computable predicate is at the **leaf** level, not the parent level: "no leaf has action `pass` or `fail`". That covers both the empty-parents case (filter matched nothing) and the all-skipped case, and today's `Total: 0` grep covers only the first.

**Tests for this package:** **none.** `find` over `e2e/cmd` returns only `main.go`; there is no `main_test.go` or any `*_test.go` anywhere under `e2e/cmd/`. A new guard would be the package's first test.

## 3. Existing "ran nothing" guards — three sites, six copies of one of them

**(a) `/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/bug-investigation/e2e/tests/main_test.go:93-110`**
```go
// Preflight: at least one agent must be registered. Registration happens in
// each agent package's init, and is conditional on E2E_AGENT naming that
// agent AND its binary being on PATH at process start. When nothing
// registers, the missing-binaries loop above has nothing to iterate,
// ForEachAgent calls t.Skip in every test, and the run exits 0 — the suite
// reports success having exercised nothing. Measured on this suite: with
// E2E_AGENT=vogon and vogon absent from PATH, 54 of 56 tests skip and
// `go test -tags=e2e ./e2e/tests` passes in 1.5s.
//
// The e2e canary is the deterministic gate that guards checkpoint capture
// on every PR, so a green run that ran nothing is worse than a red one.
// Fail the same way a missing binary does.
if len(agents.All()) == 0 {
    fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr,
        "preflight: no agents registered (E2E_AGENT=%q); every test would skip and the run would report success\n",
        os.Getenv("E2E_AGENT"))
    os.Exit(1)
}
```
Covers: zero agents registered (bad `E2E_AGENT`, agent binary off PATH at process start). **Misses:** a `-run` filter matching no test (TestMain still runs, `m.Run()` returns 0 with agents registered); and per-test skips where agents *are* registered but every matched test skips (`ForEachAgent`'s own `t.Skip` at `e2e/testutil/repo.go:381`, `ForEachNamedAgent`'s at `:404`, and the 13 in-test `t.Skip`s listed below).

Validating the design while that runs. The short version of where this is heading:

**The guard belongs in `testreport`**, not in YAML — it already computes the counts, and it's the one place all four filter-accepting entry points funnel through, so `nightly-e2e.yml`'s six greps, `e2e-windows.yml`, `e2e-isolated.yml` and every `mise run test:e2e <TestName>` a developer or agent types all inherit it at once.

**The condition is `total == 0`, not "nothing passed".** That distinction is what makes it safe: a filter naming a real test always yields at least one parent even when every subtest skips, so the legitimately-all-skipped lanes stay green, while a typo yields zero parents and goes red.

One wrinkle the exploration turned up that I'd have missed: `_default` runs under `set -eu`, so a non-zero `testreport` **already** aborts the script — but in doing so it discards gotestsum's real exit code and skips the artifacts-path echo you need for triage. So the change isn't only Go; the exit plumbing in all four call sites needs fixing too, and `canary`'s vogon lane aborting would silently cancel its roger-roger lane.

<result>I verified every claim in the brief against the tree, and found three things that reshape the design. Here is the analysis, then the plan.

---

## Verdict on the core choice

**`total == 0` is right.** It is the only predicate that is (a) unreachable for a filter naming a real test, (b) reachable for every no-match filter, and (c) unchanged in meaning by the counting bug. I found no counterexample. The leaf-level alternative would be wrong, and I have hard evidence below.

But three findings change the *shape* of the implementation.

### Finding 1 (kills the "distinct exit code" idea): `go run` collapses every non-zero child status to 1

`go run` executes the built binary through `base.RunStdin`, which on any `cmd.Run()` error calls `base.Errorf` — and `Errorf` is `log.Printf` + `SetExitStatus(1)`:

- `/Users/gtrrz-victor/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.26.6/src/cmd/go/internal/run/run.go:198-211` — "We ignore exit status", calls `base.RunStdin(cmdline)`
- `.../internal/base/base.go:229-236` — `err := cmd.Run(); if err != nil { Errorf("%v", err) }`
- `.../internal/base/base.go:142-145` — `Errorf` → `SetExitStatus(1)`

So all four call sites invoke testreport via `go run` and can only ever observe `1`. Choosing exit code 2 or 3 buys nothing and adds a `go: exit status 3` line to stderr at the exact moment you want a clean message. **Use exit 1**, and let the stderr message carry the meaning. The shell only needs "testreport failed / did not fail", which is also what `set -e` gives today — the change is that failing no longer aborts before the triage output.

### Finding 2 (a second, unreported bug on the same lines): `cat entire-version.txt 2>/dev/null` aborts under `set -e`

`_default:49`, `roger-roger:43`, `canary:73` all run a bare `cat` of a file that `TestMain` writes at `e2e/tests/main_test.go:121` — *after* the preflights that `os.Exit(1)` at `:90` and `:109`. So on any preflight failure the file does not exist, `cat` returns 1, `set -eu` (`_default:7`) aborts, and the artifacts-path echo at `:50` never runs. That is the same failure mode the brief attributes only to testreport, and it is present on a strictly more common path. Requirement 4 ("the echo still runs in both cases") is not satisfied by fixing testreport alone. Needs `|| true`.

### Finding 3: the report itself prints `🎉 ALL 0 TESTS PASSED 🎉`

`e2e/cmd/testreport/main.go:246-260` has no zero case. The artifact a human (and `.claude/skills/e2e/debug.md:46`, which reads `report.nocolor.txt`) opens after a no-match run says *all tests passed*. Fixing only the exit code leaves the lie in the file that gets uploaded to CI. The banner must change in the same commit.

---

## 1. Is `total == 0` unreachable for a filter naming a real test?

Yes, for every shape. `parseEvents` creates a `parentTest` from **either** a parent event (`main.go:118-129`) **or** any child event (`main.go:131-141`), so a parent entry exists if a single event in the run carried a non-empty `Test`.

I confirmed each shape against real recorded events in `/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/bug-investigation/e2e/artifacts/canary-2026-08-13T13-40-06/test-events-vogon.json`:

| Shape | Real example | Events | Parents |
|---|---|---|---|
| Parent skips at parent level, no subtests | `alternates_test.go:28` (`t.Skip` before any `ForEachAgent`) | `skip` with `Test="TestAlternates_..."` | 1 |
| Parent passes, no subtests | `TestAlternates_RelativeObjectAlternate_CheckpointSync` — recorded as `['pass'] children: []` | `pass` | 1 |
| Parent passes, **all** children skip | `TestCodexResumeRestoredSessionWithSanitizedCompactedHistory` → `['pass'] children: [('vogon', ['skip'])]`; same for `TestFactoryTaskCheckpointExistsBeforeCommit`, `TestFactoryCommittedCheckpointExcludesPreExistingUntrackedFiles`, `TestExternalAgentMultipleTurnsManualCommit` | parent `pass` + child `skip` | 1 |
| Mixed | any multi-agent run | ≥2 | ≥1 |
| Panic mid-run (no terminal action) | — | `output` with `Test!=""` still creates an entry with `action=""` (rendered `?` by `statusIcon`) | ≥1 |

This is the decisive evidence for rejecting the leaf-level guard: that vogon report's header reads `Total: 56  Passed: 56  Failed: 0  Skipped: 0` while **four** of those parents ran zero real leaves. A "no leaf passed or failed" guard would have to turn `mise run test:e2e:canary TestCodexResume…` red, and `e2e-isolated.yml`'s default input `TestInteractiveMultiStep` red on every non-interactive agent (`interactive_test.go:19` skips *inside* the `ForEachAgent` closure, i.e. at leaf level). `total == 0` cannot fire on any of them.

**One asymmetry I checked and cleared:** `canary:61` forces the user's filter onto the roger-roger lane, but `-run` filters by test *name* against the *same compiled binary* in both lanes (`canary:40` and `canary:65`). A filter matching ≥1 test in the vogon lane matches ≥1 in the roger-roger lane. `total == 0` is therefore symmetric across canary's lanes — a filter cannot legitimately be green in one and empty in the other.

**Known gap, accept explicitly:** a *subtest-path* filter (`-run 'TestFoo/nonexistant-agent'`) runs the parent, which passes with no children — 1 parent, guard silent. No call site in this repo constructs one (agents are selected via `E2E_AGENT`, and the skill docs teach `test:e2e --agent <agent> <TestName>`), so this stays out of scope. Say so in the code comment rather than pretending it is covered.

## 2. What else reaches `total == 0`, and is failing right?

| Cause | `total` | gotestsum rc today | Right outcome | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-run` matched nothing | 0 | **0** | red | The target. `go test` prints `testing: warning: no tests to run` and exits 0. |
| `./e2e/tests` build failure | 0 | ≠0 | red | Already red. Guard only adds a message. |
| Invalid `-run` regex | 0 | ≠0 | red | Already red. **This is why the message must not assert "your filter matched nothing" as fact.** |
| `TestMain` preflight exit (`main_test.go:90`, `:109`) | 0 | ≠0 | red | Already red; and this is the path that also trips Finding 2. |
| gotestsum crash / SIGKILL, truncated jsonfile | 0 or partial | ≠0 | red | Already red. A partial file with ≥1 test event yields ≥1 parent, so no false positive. |
| jsonfile absent entirely | n/a | ≠0 | red | `openInput` fails → `main.go:48` exits 1 already. Preserve that path. |
| `--rerun-fails` (`_default:42`) | unchanged | 0 on no-match | red | Verified in gotestsum v1.13.0 source: `cmd/main.go:315` returns `finishRun` early when `exitErr == nil`, so reruns never engage on a no-match run. Reruns also append to the same jsonfile, so `parseEvents` (`main.go:106-109`, last action wins) reports a fail-then-pass test as `pass` — existing behavior, not touched here. |
| `-count=1` | no effect | — | — | — |

Every non-target cause is **already** non-zero from gotestsum. So the guard is purely additive on exit codes, provided the plumbing gives gotestsum precedence — which it must, so that a build failure reports gotestsum's status, not a generic 1. The stderr message will still print on those paths, hence the wording below.

## 3. Unconditional, not behind a flag

Unconditional. Arguments:

- Every consumer of `testreport` is one of the four lanes (verified: `grep -rn testreport` outside artifacts hits only `mise-tasks/test/e2e/{_default,canary,roger-roger}`). There is no reader for whom zero tests is a correct green.
- The repo has already ruled on this twice, in prose: `e2e/tests/main_test.go:97-104` ("a green run that ran nothing is worse than a red one") and the two canary preflights at `canary:29-35` and `canary:50-59` ("the lane would skip every test and still report success"). A flag would make this codebase's stated policy opt-in.
- `nightly-e2e.yml:199` already applies it unconditionally to six lanes. A flag would mean the six existing greps must be replaced by six `-fail-on-no-tests` flags — same duplication, new spelling.
- A flag has a failure mode an unconditional guard does not: someone adds a fifth call site and forgets the flag. That is exactly how the current 6-copy grep drifted.

The only argument for a flag is "someone might render a report for a hand-picked subset of a jsonfile". No such caller exists, and if one appears, `-o /dev/null` plus ignoring the status is a one-line workaround at that call site.

## 4. Exit-code plumbing (exact shell)

### `mise-tasks/test/e2e/_default` — replace lines 42-51

```sh
rc=0
gotestsum --format dots --rerun-fails=1 --packages=./e2e/tests \
  --jsonfile "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/test-events.json" -- \
  -tags=e2e -count=1 -timeout=30m \
  ${filter:+-run "$filter"} || rc=$?

# Captured, not fatal. testreport exits non-zero when the run produced no
# tests at all — a -run filter that matched nothing exits 0 from `go test`,
# and gotestsum v1.13.0 has no flag for it. Its verdict must not pre-empt the
# artifacts path below, which is the only thing a developer has to triage
# with, and gotestsum's own status outranks it: on a build failure or a
# TestMain preflight exit both are non-zero, and gotestsum's is the specific
# one. `go run` collapses any non-zero child status to 1
# (cmd/go/internal/base.RunStdin), so this is a boolean, not a code.
report_rc=0
go run ./e2e/cmd/testreport -color -o "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/report.txt" \
  "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/test-events.json" || report_rc=$?

echo ""
# `|| true`: TestMain writes this file only after its preflights pass, so a
# preflight failure leaves it absent — and under `set -e` a failing cat would
# abort here, before the artifacts path is printed.
cat "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/entire-version.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "artifacts: $E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR"

if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  exit "$rc"
fi
exit "$report_rc"
```

### `mise-tasks/test/e2e/roger-roger` — replace lines 36-45

Identical shape, with its own gotestsum invocation preserved verbatim (no `--rerun-fails`, wildcard package arg, 10m timeout):

```sh
rc=0
gotestsum --format dots --jsonfile "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/test-events.json" -- \
  -tags=e2e -count=1 -timeout=10m \
  ${filter:+-run "$filter"} \
  ./e2e/tests/... || rc=$?

report_rc=0
go run ./e2e/cmd/testreport -color -o "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/report.txt" \
  "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/test-events.json" || report_rc=$?

echo ""
cat "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/entire-version.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "artifacts: $E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR"

if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  exit "$rc"
fi
exit "$report_rc"
```

### `mise-tasks/test/e2e/canary` — both lanes

At `:23-24`, extend the accumulator block:

```sh
vogon_rc=0
rr_rc=0
vogon_report_rc=0
rr_report_rc=0
```

Vogon lane, replacing `:43-45`:

```sh
go run ./e2e/cmd/testreport -color \
  -o "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/report-vogon.txt" \
  "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/test-events-vogon.json" || vogon_report_rc=$?
```

Roger-roger lane, replacing `:68-70`:

```sh
go run ./e2e/cmd/testreport -color \
  -o "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/report-roger-roger.txt" \
  "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/test-events-roger-roger.json" || rr_report_rc=$?
```

Tail, replacing `:72-77`:

```sh
echo ""
cat "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/entire-version.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "artifacts: $E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR"
# Every lane's verdict is collapsed to a single 1, as before: the two reports
# above name which lane failed. Capturing the testreport statuses (rather than
# letting `set -e` abort on them) is what keeps a vogon-lane no-tests verdict
# from cancelling the roger-roger lane entirely.
if [ "$vogon_rc" -ne 0 ] || [ "$rr_rc" -ne 0 ] ||
  [ "$vogon_report_rc" -ne 0 ] || [ "$rr_report_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  exit 1
fi
```

The `|| vogon_report_rc=$?` at `:43` is precisely what prevents the vogon-lane abort described in the brief: with `set -e` and a bare `go run`, a vogon-lane guard hit today would exit before `:48` and the roger-roger lane would never run. Note also that `canary` currently has no trailing `exit 0` — falling off the end after the `if` preserves that.

Run `mise run lint:shellcheck` after: it globs `mise-tasks` by shebang and all three files are in scope.

## Verdict on the core choice

**`total == 0` is right.** It is the only predicate that is (a) unreachable for a filter naming a real test, (b) reachable for every no-match filter, and (c) unchanged in meaning by the counting bug. I found no counterexample. The leaf-level alternative would be wrong, and I have hard evidence below.

But three findings change the *shape* of the implementation.

### Finding 1 (kills the "distinct exit code" idea): `go run` collapses every non-zero child status to 1

`go run` executes the built binary through `base.RunStdin`, which on any `cmd.Run()` error calls `base.Errorf` — and `Errorf` is `log.Printf` + `SetExitStatus(1)`:

- `/Users/gtrrz-victor/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.26.6/src/cmd/go/internal/run/run.go:198-211` — "We ignore exit status", calls `base.RunStdin(cmdline)`
- `.../internal/base/base.go:229-236` — `err := cmd.Run(); if err != nil { Errorf("%v", err) }`
- `.../internal/base/base.go:142-145` — `Errorf` → `SetExitStatus(1)`

So all four call sites invoke testreport via `go run` and can only ever observe `1`. Choosing exit code 2 or 3 buys nothing and adds a `go: exit status 3` line to stderr at the exact moment you want a clean message. **Use exit 1**, and let the stderr message carry the meaning. ## 1. Is `total == 0` unreachable for a filter naming a real test?

Yes, for every shape. `parseEvents` creates a `parentTest` from **either** a parent event (`main.go:118-129`) **or** any child event (`main.go:131-141`), so a parent entry exists if a single event in the run carried a non-empty `Test`.

I confirmed each shape against real recorded events in `/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/bug-investigation/e2e/artifacts/canary-2026-08-13T13-40-06/test-events-vogon.json`:

| Shape | Real example | Events | Parents |

| Parent skips at parent level, no subtests | `alternates_test.go:28` (`t.Skip` before any `ForEachAgent`) | `skip` with `Test="TestAlternates_..."` | 1 |
| Parent passes, no subtests | `TestAlternates_RelativeObjectAlternate_CheckpointSync` — recorded as `['pass'] children: []` | `pass` | 1 |
| Parent passes, **all** children skip | `TestCodexResumeRestoredSessionWithSanitizedCompactedHistory` → `['pass'] children: [('vogon', ['skip'])]`; same for `TestFactoryTaskCheckpointExistsBeforeCommit`, `TestFactoryCommittedCheckpointExcludesPreExistingUntrackedFiles`, `TestExternalAgentMultipleTurnsManualCommit` | parent `pass` + child `skip` | 1 |

| Panic mid-run (no terminal action) | — | `output` with `Test!=""` still creates an entry with `action=""` (rendered `?` by `statusIcon`) | ≥1 |

This is the decisive evidence for rejecting the leaf-level guard: that vogon report's header reads `Total: 56  Passed: 56  Failed: 0  Skipped: 0` while **four** of those parents ran zero real leaves. A "no leaf passed or failed" guard would have to turn `mise run test:e2e:canary TestCodexResume…` red, and `e2e-isolated.yml`'s default input `TestInteractiveMultiStep` red on every non-interactive agent (`interactive_test.go:19` skips *inside* the `ForEachAgent` closure, i.e. at leaf level). `total == 0` cannot fire on any of them.

**One asymmetry I checked and cleared:** `canary:61` forces the user's filter onto the roger-roger lane, but `-run` filters by test *name* against the *same compiled binary* in both lanes (`canary:40` and `canary:65`). A filter matching ≥1 test in the vogon lane matches ≥1 in the roger-roger lane. `total == 0` is therefore symmetric across canary's lanes — a filter cannot legitimately be green in one and empty in the other.

**Known gap, accept explicitly:** a *subtest-path* filter (`-run 'TestFoo/nonexistant-agent'`) runs the parent, which passes with no children — 1 parent, guard silent. No call site in this repo constructs one (agents are selected via `E2E_AGENT`, and the skill docs teach `test:e2e --agent <agent> <TestName>`), so this stays out of scope. Say so in the code comment rather than pretending it is covered.

## 3. Unconditional, not behind a flag

Unconditional. Arguments:

- Every consumer of `testreport` is one of the four lanes (verified: `grep -rn testreport` outside artifacts hits only `mise-tasks/test/e2e/{_default,canary,roger-roger}`). There is no reader for whom zero tests is a correct green.

A flag would make this codebase's stated policy opt-in.
- `nightly-e2e.yml:199` already applies it unconditionally to six lanes. A flag would mean the six existing greps must be replaced by six `-fail-on-no-tests` flags — same duplication, new spelling.
- A flag has a failure mode an unconditional guard does not: someone adds a fifth call site and forgets the flag. That is exactly how the current 6-copy grep drifted.

The only argument for a flag is "someone might render a report for a hand-picked subset of a jsonfile". No such caller exists, and if one appears, `-o /dev/null` plus ignoring the status is a one-line workaround at that call site.

# Fail an e2e run whose filter matched no test

## Context

`go test -run <no match>` prints `testing: warning: no tests to run` and **exits 0**.
gotestsum v1.13.0 has no flag for it (checked its full flag list). So a typo in a test
name produces a fully green run that tested nothing.

Today exactly one caller guards this: `.github/workflows/nightly-e2e.yml` greps
`^Total: 0 ` out of the report, in six copied lines. Every other filter-accepting entry
point is unguarded — `e2e-windows.yml:47` and `e2e-isolated.yml:83` (both take a
user-supplied `test` input), and every `mise run test:e2e --agent <agent> <TestName>`
a developer or agent types, which the skill docs teach in eight places.

Two concrete consequences beyond the typo: `e2e.yml:141` and
`e2e-checkpoint-store.yml:157` hardcode `test:e2e:roger-roger TestExternalAgent`, so
renaming that test turns those legs permanently and silently green.

Fix it once, where the count already exists.

## The design

**Guard in `e2e/cmd/testreport`, on `total == 0` — zero parent tests.**

`parseEvents` drops every event with `Test == ""` (`main.go:96-98`), so a no-match run
yields zero parents while any named test yields at least one. All four filter-accepting
mise tasks already pipe through testreport, so every workflow and every local invocation
inherits the guard with no per-caller code.

**Why `total == 0` and not "no leaf passed or failed".** All-skipped runs are legitimate
and routine here, and a leaf-level predicate would turn them red:
`mise run test:e2e:canary TestFactory…` is 100% skips by construction, and
`e2e-isolated.yml`'s *default* input `TestInteractiveMultiStep` skips on every agent
without interactive mode (`e2e/tests/interactive_test.go:19`). Those all still emit a
parent event, so `total == 0` cannot fire on them. This is the whole reason the guard is
safe — record it in the code comment so a later "fix" to the counting cannot break it.

Not covered, deliberately: a subtest-path filter (`-run TestFoo/typo`) runs the parent,
which passes childless. No call site builds one; agents come from `E2E_AGENT`.

## Three gotchas found while validating (all verified in-tree)

1. **`go run` collapses any non-zero child status to 1** (`cmd/go/internal/base.RunStdin`
   → `Errorf` → `SetExitStatus(1)`). A distinct exit code buys nothing and adds a
   `go: exit status N` line. Exit 1; let stderr carry the meaning.
2. **`mise-tasks/test/e2e/_default` runs under `set -eu` with a bare `go run` (:47) and a
   bare `cat entire-version.txt` (:49).** So testreport failing already aborts the script
   — discarding gotestsum's real rc and skipping the artifacts-path echo, the one thing a
   developer triages with. The `cat` has the same bug independently: `TestMain` writes that
   file only after its preflights, so a preflight exit makes `cat` fail and abort. Both need
   capturing (`|| rc=$?`, `|| true`).
3. **The report banner has no zero case** (`main.go:253-259`): `total == 0` renders
   `🎉 ALL 0 TESTS PASSED 🎉` into `report.txt`, the artifact CI uploads and
   `.claude/skills/e2e/debug.md:46` tells agents to read. Must change in the same commit.

## Changes

**`e2e/cmd/testreport/main.go`** — two edits.
- `renderReport`: add a `total == 0` banner case (`💥 NO TESTS RAN 💥`) to the existing
  `if failed > 0 / else` at :246-260.
- `main()`: after the `-o` block (:69), `if len(parents) == 0` → print an actionable
  stderr message naming the events file and splitting the two hypotheses (filter matched
  nothing / build failure, invalid regex, TestMain preflight), then `os.Exit(1)`. It must
  not assert the filter was wrong: build failures reach the same condition.

**`e2e/cmd/testreport/main_test.go`** — new, the package's first test. `package main`,
no build tag, so `mise run test` and `test:ci` pick it up. Table-driven over synthetic
test2json lines against `parseEvents` and `renderReport(parents, false)`. Cases: no events;
**package-only events** (the no-match shape, the regression test); parent-only pass;
**parent-level skip**; **parent pass + all children skip** (the two boundary rows that must
stay green); parent fail with failing child; malformed lines mixed with valid; malformed
only; rerun shape (fail-then-pass → `pass`, last wins).

**`mise-tasks/test/e2e/{_default,roger-roger,canary}`** — capture testreport's status
instead of letting `set -e` abort, and make the triage tail unconditional:
```sh
report_rc=0
go run ./e2e/cmd/testreport … || report_rc=$?
echo ""
cat "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/entire-version.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "artifacts: $E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR"
[ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && exit "$rc"
exit "$report_rc"
```
gotestsum's status outranks the guard, so a build failure still reports its own specific
code. In `canary`, do this per lane (`vogon_report_rc`, `rr_report_rc`) and fold both into
the existing `vogon_rc`/`rr_rc` aggregation — capturing is what stops a vogon-lane verdict
from cancelling the roger-roger lane, which the current bare `go run` would.

## Scope and sequencing

Separate branch off `main`, not PR #2159. That PR is a workflow; this is shared Go and
mise infrastructure — one objective each. Leave #2159's six greps alone; delete them in a
follow-up once both land (they are harmless belt-and-braces, and identical in predicate).

Out of scope, file separately: **the parent-only counting bug** — `renderReport` counts a
parent whose children all skipped as `Passed`, proven by a checked-in artifact reading
`Total: 56  Passed: 56` where four parents ran only skipped leaves. Real, but it changes
every number people read, and bundling it destroys this change's key review property: exit
codes provably unchanged for every currently-green run. Any later fix must keep the guard
on the **parent** count.

## Verification

1. `go test ./e2e/cmd/testreport` — the new table, written before the guard so the
   no-match and all-skipped rows pin the boundary in both directions.
2. `mise run test:e2e --agent claude-code TestNoSuchTest` → red, and the report, version
   block and artifacts path all still print, in that order. Makes **no API calls**: nothing
   matches, so no agent runs.
3. `mise run test:e2e:roger-roger TestExternalAgent` still green; `…TestNope` red.
4. `mise run test:e2e:canary` green; `…TestNope` red **and** the transcript shows the
   roger-roger lane still ran after the vogon verdict; `…TestFactoryTaskRecordExistsBeforeCommit`
   still green — the all-skipped regression.
5. `mise run lint` (shellcheck globs `mise-tasks` by shebang) and `mise run check`.

`parseEvents` drops every event with `Test == ""` (`main.go:96-98`), so a no-match run
yields zero parents while any named test yields at least one. All four filter-accepting
mise tasks already pipe through testreport, so every workflow and every local invocation
inherits the guard with no per-caller code.

**Why `total == 0` and not "no leaf passed or failed".** All-skipped runs are legitimate
and routine here, and a leaf-level predicate would turn them red:
`mise run test:e2e:canary TestFactory…` is 100% skips by construction, and
`e2e-isolated.yml`'s *default* input `TestInteractiveMultiStep` skips on every agent
without interactive mode (`e2e/tests/interactive_test.go:19`). Those all still emit a
parent event, so `total == 0` cannot fire on them. This is the whole reason the guard is
safe — record it in the code comment so a later "fix" to the counting cannot break it.

Not covered, deliberately: a subtest-path filter (`-run TestFoo/typo`) runs the parent,
which passes childless. No call site builds one; agents come from `E2E_AGENT`.

## Three gotchas found while validating (all verified in-tree)

1. **`go run` collapses any non-zero child status to 1** (`cmd/go/internal/base.RunStdin`
   → `Errorf` → `SetExitStatus(1)`). A distinct exit code buys nothing and adds a
   `go: exit status N` line. Exit 1; let stderr carry the meaning.
2. **`mise-tasks/test/e2e/_default` runs under `set -eu` with a bare `go run` (:47) and a
   bare `cat entire-version.txt` (:49).** So testreport failing already aborts the script
   — discarding gotestsum's real rc and skipping the artifacts-path echo, the one thing a
   developer triages with. The `cat` has the same bug independently: `TestMain` writes that
   file only after its preflights, so a preflight exit makes `cat` fail and abort. Both need
   capturing (`|| rc=$?`, `|| true`).
3. **The report banner has no zero case** (`main.go:253-259`): `total == 0` renders
   `🎉 ALL 0 TESTS PASSED 🎉` into `report.txt`, the artifact CI uploads and
   `.claude/skills/e2e/debug.md:46` tells agents to read. Must change in the same commit.

## Changes

**`e2e/cmd/testreport/main.go`** — two edits.
- `renderReport`: add a `total == 0` banner case (`💥 NO TESTS RAN 💥`) to the existing
  `if failed > 0 / else` at :246-260.
- `main()`: after the `-o` block (:69), `if len(parents) == 0` → print an actionable
  stderr message naming the events file and splitting the two hypotheses (filter matched
  nothing / build failure, invalid regex, TestMain preflight), then `os.Exit(1)`. It must
  not assert the filter was wrong: build failures reach the same condition.

**`e2e/cmd/testreport/main_test.go`** — new, the package's first test. `package main`,
no build tag, so `mise run test` and `test:ci` pick it up. Table-driven over synthetic
test2json lines against `parseEvents` and `renderReport(parents, false)`. Cases: no events;
**package-only events** (the no-match shape, the regression test); parent-only pass;
**parent-level skip**; **parent pass + all children skip** (the two boundary rows that must
stay green); parent fail with failing child; malformed lines mixed with valid; malformed
only; rerun shape (fail-then-pass → `pass`, last wins).

**`mise-tasks/test/e2e/{_default,roger-roger,canary}`** — capture testreport's status
instead of letting `set -e` abort, and make the triage tail unconditional:
```sh

go run ./e2e/cmd/testreport … || report_rc=$?
echo ""
cat "$E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR/entire-version.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "artifacts: $E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR"
[ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && exit "$rc"
exit "$report_rc"
```
gotestsum's status outranks the guard, so a build failure still reports its own specific
code. In `canary`, do this per lane (`vogon_report_rc`, `rr_report_rc`) and fold both into
the existing `vogon_rc`/`rr_rc` aggregation — capturing is what stops a vogon-lane verdict
from cancelling the roger-roger lane, which the current bare `go run` would.

## Scope and sequencing

Separate branch off `main`, not PR #2159. That PR is a workflow; this is shared Go and
mise infrastructure — one objective each. Leave #2159's six greps alone; delete them in a
follow-up once both land (they are harmless belt-and-braces, and identical in predicate).

Out of scope, file separately: **the parent-only counting bug** — `renderReport` counts a
parent whose children all skipped as `Passed`, proven by a checked-in artifact reading
`Total: 56  Passed: 56` where four parents ran only skipped leaves. Real, but it changes
every number people read, and bundling it destroys this change's key review property: exit
codes provably unchanged for every currently-green run. Any later fix must keep the guard
on the **parent** count.

1. `go test ./e2e/cmd/testreport` — the new table, written before the guard so the
   no-match and all-skipped rows pin the boundary in both directions.
2. `mise run test:e2e --agent claude-code TestNoSuchTest` → red, and the report, version
   block and artifacts path all still print, in that order. Makes **no API calls**: nothing
   matches, so no agent runs.

4. `mise run test:e2e:canary` green; `…TestNope` red **and** the transcript shows the

   still green — the all-skipped regression.
